description: This file contains code for the EmployeeAttendanceTool doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, functions for retrieving and marking employee attendance, and their associated logic.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceTool
classes.description: A Document subclass representing employee attendance tools, currently with no additional attributes or methods.

methods.name: get_employees(date, department = None, branch = None, company = None)
methods.description: Fetches the list of active employees for a given date, optionally filtered by department, branch, or company, and returns their attendance status.

methods.name: mark_employee_attendance(employee_list, status, date, leave_type=None, company=None)
methods.description: Marks attendance for a list of employees on a specified date with a given status and optional leave type.

ctags.name: get_employees
ctags.pattern: /^def get_employees(date, department = None, branch = None, company = None):$/
ctags.signature: (date, department = None, branch = None, company = None)
